business_summary: BoardWare Intelligence Technology Limited provides enterprise IT solutions in Macau, Hong Kong, the People's Republic of China, and internationally. It offers professional IT services, network configuration, assessment of system specifications and requirements, procurement and delivery of hardware and software, and installation of equipment and software. The company also provides managed services, such as leasing IT equipment to its customers under finance lease arrangements; security monitoring services to protect customers' information and data security; and network operating environment solutions. In addition, it distributes, sells, and resells various packaged IT hardware and software products and solutions; offers IT maintenance and consultancy services comprising on-site support and technical support services for the customers, and post sales maintenance, support and software development services. Further, the company is involved in research and development activities; and provision of IT solution services consists of procurement and integration services. The company was founded in 2010 and is headquartered in Macau, Macau. BoardWare Intelligence Technology Limited operates as a subsidiary of Tai Wah (BVI) Holdings Limited.
